label: Ātma-Nivedana Song Seven
title: nivedana kori prabhu tomāra caraṇe
metaDescription: Ātma-Nivedana Song Seven: (nivedana kori prabhu tomāra caraṇe) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.translation: I submit at Your lotus feet, O Lord, that I am fallen and most wretched. This fact is known to the three worlds.
There is no sinner in the world more sinful than me. In the entire universe there is no offender whose offenses equal mine.

translit: sei saba pāpa āra aparādha, āmi
parihāre pāi lajjā, saba jāno’ tumi
verses.translation: By attempting to clear myself of all these sins and offenses I am put to shame. All this is surely understood by You.
deva: सेइ सब पाप आर अपराध, आमि
परिहारे पाइ लज्जा, सब जानो’ तुमि
bengali: সেই সব পাপ আর অপরাধ, আমি
পরিহারে পাই লজ্জা, সব জানো’ তুমি

translit: tumi binā kā’ra āmi loibo śaraṇ?
verses.translation: Of whom will I take shelter except for You? You are the Lord of all lords, O son of the King of Vraja!
deva: तुमि बिना का’र आमि लोइबो शरण्?
bengali: তুমি বিনা কা’র আমি লোইবো শরণ্?

translit: tomā prati aparādha tumi koro’ kṣoy
verses.translation: This world is Yours, O Lord, and You pervade all things in it. You dispel the sinful result of offenses committed against You.
deva: तोमा प्रति अपराध तुमि कोरो’ क्षोय्
bengali: তোমা প্রতি অপরাধ তুমি কোরো’ ক্ষোয্

translit: tumi binā āra kibā āche, doyā-moy!
verses.translation: You alone are the shelter of those whose feet stumble off the proper path. Apart from You, what else exists, O merciful Lord?
deva: तुमि बिना आर किबा आछे, दोया-मोय्!
bengali: তুমি বিনা আর কিবা আছে, দোযা-মোয্!

verses.translation: All persons like me who have offended You will ultimately seek to achieve Your shelter.
Bhaktivinoda now takes full shelter of You and surrenders himself at Your lotus feet on this very day.
